name: com.foreverworks/esanatateamea
title: eSănătateaMea
description: Read your Romanian health records: insurance, prescriptions, paid care, documents and appointments.

environmentVariables.name: ESANATATEAMEA_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: The e-mail address you sign in to eSănătateaMea with; leave empty to sign in with ROeID instead.

environmentVariables.name: ESANATATEAMEA_PASSWORD_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of a file holding only your eSănătateaMea password; leave empty to sign in with ROeID instead.

environmentVariables.name: ESANATATEAMEA_TOTP_SECRET_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of a file holding the authenticator app's key for the account, so the server types the six-digit code itself; leave empty to be asked for the code.
